title: Make sure you have enough, correct wiring for the power to this. Very, very difficult to put together
text:
Make sure you have enough, correct wiring for the power to this. Very, very difficult to put together. Be prepared for lots and lots of serious cursing inspired by pure frustration. This unit seems like a neat idea at first. It might be in limited circumstances. For me though, this has been a huge hassle.

It comes in an enormous, 150lbs box. Every piece is flat packed for easy shipping, but that translates to full construction from minute one for the end user. The instructions are fuzzy at best and the entire process is very complicated and time consuming. It took me a total of 6 hours over three days to get the thing put together - with a helper on the last day.

It isn't as solid or sturdy as I expected either. That might be poor construction on my part, I'm honestly not sure. The heater part might work fine, but like another reviewer noted, if you use the heat and a big tv and a cable box, you risk losing power or throwing a breaker. Make sure you have enough dedicated power in the spot you use this. I will have to relocate it if we intend to watch tv and use the heater at the same time. For now, it's basically a big bookshelf with a faux fireplace in the center in a guest room.
